pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Voltage is, and how we get the newest looks to you first at prices that keep up with the trend cycle.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: Voltage is fast fashion done right — hundreds of new styles every week, across dresses, denim, tops, sets and swim, at prices built to move. We watch what the street is actually wearing, make it quickly, and pass the speed straight on to you.

Priced to move does not mean throwaway. We size every run to sell through, mark the real comparison price on every tag, and keep the best-sellers restocked so the thing you loved on Monday is still there on Friday. Free 1-day shipping over $75, easy 30-day returns, and a sale rail that never quite runs out.
